title: Lanthanide-containing clusters for catalytic water splitting and CO2 conversion
claim: Electrocatalytic HER with LnCCs is rarely reported because the clusters generally have poor conductivity and are unstable under electrocatalytic conditions.
explanation: After reviewing photocatalytic LnCC HER systems, the authors state that conductivity and stability limit electrocatalysis and list three directions: loading on conductive supports such as heteroatom-doped carbon, partial encapsulation in metal oxides, and construction of precise Ce-based LnCC electrocatalysts.
caveats: LnW11 is an exception that was also tested electrocatalytically; the limitation is stated as the prevailing situation, not an absolute absence of examples.
